Gather catalyst information and analysis as part of the finance tearsheet workflow.

args.data: This note coordinates the two workstreams for the finance tearsheet workflow: valuation analysis and catalyst analysis. The valuation-analyst is tasked with gathering valuation data and analysis, while the catalyst-analyst is tasked with gathering catalyst information and analysis.
args.name: Coordinator Note on Workstreams
